integrity: Definitions, proof, and finite checker are provided; numerical checks are finite and do not establish the universal theorem or originality. Full independent scientific and bibliographic audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only real and complex 3-coordinate ell_p spaces, \(1<p<\infty\), and nilpotent weighted shifts with two consecutive edges; no longer shifts, endpoint exponents, or global p-dependent quartic ordering extension claimed. Numerical sampling is not proof.
title: A mixed-Luxemburg law for the spatial numerical radius of two-link shifts
